title: Your suitcase is found—pay the courier
scenario: Hours after reporting a missing bag, a message quotes your surname and baggage tag number. It says the suitcase is ready for delivery but a €18 courier fee must be paid within 30 minutes or delivery moves to tomorrow.

answers.A: Check the baggage-tracing portal or call the airline/baggage desk using the reference you received when you filed the report.
answers.B: Ask the sender for the airline case number, then compare it with your own report before doing anything else.
answers.C: Pay the small delivery fee because the baggage tag number would be difficult for a scammer to know.

explanation: Baggage details can leak through tags, systems, or prior messages. Verify the delivery inside the claim channel you already established.
proTip: Specific data can make a scam specific—not authentic.
